watchdogs.name: host_status
watchdogs.prompt: Host status tick ({milestone}), one batched turn: `df -h .`, `sysctl vm.swapusage`, the stack-lock owner file under `stack.isolation.lock_dir`, ListAgents. Apply the restart and pre-run rules of docs/gsd/host-ops.md (restart only below the disk threshold or on a stalled container or bucket, never for swap alone, through one owner at a plan boundary). One or two lines: disk, swap GB, lock owner.

watchdogs.name: delivery_report
watchdogs.prompt: Delivery report ({milestone}), as ONE `{utility_model}` agent (read-only): from `git log --since="4 hours ago" --oneline` and the SUMMARY and VERIFICATION files modified in that window, report in 3-5 lines plans and phases closed, commit count, notable fixes, next up, blockers; note a CHECKPOINT.json stale against its SUMMARYs. Facts only; relay it to the chat, correcting anything the disk contradicts.

watchdogs.name: cleanup
watchdogs.prompt: Periodic cleanup ({milestone}), as ONE `{utility_model}` agent, at most 8 tool calls, following the Cleanup section of docs/gsd/host-ops.md: orphan processes, `.tmp/` entries older than the age limit minus every name in `.planning/cleanup-keep.txt` (no keep list means delete nothing), the container runtime's build-cache prune (never all images, never volumes). Never touch running agents' processes, the dev server or stack containers. Report names deleted and disk before and after in two lines.
